name: engagement
title: Engagement
description: The events analytics tools capture automatically — scroll depth, outbound and contact clicks, file downloads, video plays and form submissions — with no instrumentation. Works on any site.

platforms.name: Any website
platforms.notes: No platform integration required. Reads only the DOM, so it works alongside a commerce or consent plugin.

install.platform: Google Tag Manager Custom HTML tag

options.name: scrollThresholds
options.description: Depth percentages that fire engagement.scroll. Each fires once per view.

options.name: downloadExtensions
options.description: Extensions treated as a download. Defaults to common documents, archives and media.

options.name: leadFormSelector
options.description: Forms matching this also emit lead.generate_lead on submit.

options.name: trackVideo
options.description: HTML5 video start, progress and completion.

options.name: actionPrefix
options.description: Renames the commerce prefix only; engagement and lead keep their own.

options.name: consent
options.description: auto holds events until consent is granted, ignore defers to the host page.

options.name: beforeTrack
options.description: Edit or drop an event before it is sent.

options.name: debug
options.description: Log every mapped event to the console.
